steps.title: Define Project Requirements
steps.description: Determine target specifications, permissions, UI components, and raw PCM/WAV audio amplification algorithms for Audio Booster.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Add RECORD_AUDIO permission and declare target activities inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Setup Build Configuration
steps.description: Establish build.gradle with correct JDK 17, AGP 8.3.2, compile SDK 34, and zero external dependencies.

steps.title: Design Layout XML
steps.description: Build a robust UI using standard Android views: LinearLayout, ScrollView, ListView, SeekBars, and modern material styles.

steps.title: Implement Audio Recording Service
steps.description: Write high-performance AudioRecord listener inside MainActivity to capture mono 16-bit PCM audio samples dynamically.

steps.title: Write WAV File Header Exporter
steps.description: Develop a native RIFF/WAVE header writer to package captured PCM streams into standard playable WAV files.

steps.title: Develop Amplification Algorithm
steps.description: Construct sample-level multiplier algorithm with short clamping limiters (-32768 to 32767) to boost volume dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Playback Interface
steps.description: Integrate standard Android MediaPlayer to seamlessly load and toggle between original and processed audio files.

steps.title: Add Local Directory File Explorer
steps.description: Add internal file lister to refresh dynamically, letting the user browse and select stored WAV files for amplification.

steps.title: Build Audio Booster
steps.description: Compile the final production APK for execution and deployment.
